title: FIRE
body:
**# FRIE Mod | Minecraft Forge 1.20.1**
Ignite your Minecraft world with the **FRIE Mod** — a Forge 1.20.1-exclusive content expansion that brings a fully realized fire-themed universe to your game, blending fiery combat gear, immersive natural blocks, and vanilla-aligned pixel art for a seamless, blazing adventure.
##  Core Content
### Fiery Combat Arsenal
- **Iron Rod**: The foundational crafting backbone of the mod. This sturdy metal rod is the building block for all advanced flame-themed gear, serving as your first step into the FRIE experience.
- **Fire Poker**: A reliable early-game melee weapon, perfect for fending off mobs in the Nether or adding a fiery edge to your survival fights.
- **Flaming Sword**: The mod's iconic signature weapon, which inflicts bonus fire damage on every hit, turning every battle into a spectacular display of elemental fury.
### Flaming World Blocks
- **Flaming Wood**: Glowing, fire-infused wood blocks ideal for building fiery cabins, Nether outposts, or dramatic treehouses that stand out in any biome.
- **Flaming Dirt**: A vibrant, smoldering dirt block that lets you reshape your world into a burning landscape, perfect for custom fire-themed biomes or lava-side builds.
- **Flaming Leaves**: Luminous, flame-tinged leaf blocks that add a magical glow to your trees, creating enchanted forests or fiery groves that shine brightly at night.
##  Key Features
- **Forge 1.20.1 Native Support**: Built exclusively for Minecraft Forge 1.20.1, stable and compatible with most mainstream mods.
- **Vanilla Style Texture**: All items and blocks adopt classic Minecraft pixel style, fitting perfectly with original game scenes.
- **Lightweight & Smooth**: Low resource occupation, no frame drop or performance loss during gameplay.
- **Balanced Game Progress**: Craft weapons step by step from basic iron rod to powerful flaming sword.
- **Rich Building Materials**: Diverse fire-themed blocks support you to create unique buildings and custom biomes.
Suitable for survival combat and creative construction. Bring blazing power and brand new building experience to your Minecraft journey!
